headline: Economic Expert Mohammed Anis: It Will Be Hard for Oil to Return to $60 a Barrel
summary: An economic expert says a continued rise in oil prices is unlikely, and a return to $60 per barrel or less is improbable. He cites attacks in the Strait of Hormuz and escalating confrontations.
why: Brent crude is the global benchmark for oil prices, and the Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of seaborne crude, so disruptions there move energy costs and inflation expectations.
why_moved: Attacks in the Strait of Hormuz and escalating confrontations are cited as reasons oil prices are unlikely to fall back to $60 a barrel.
